name: Connector — GROVE
description: Cluster of 4 GROVE-family (HW4) connector footprints from Seeed-OPL-Kicad-Library, covering SMD and through-hole mounts in straight and 90-degree orientations; all entries are tier C and generated, none planner-visible.
selection_hints: Match mount type: smd vs through_hole footprint variant.
Confirm the exact footprint name (SMD or non-SMD, 90D or not) fits the board layout.
All 4 parts are tier C generated entries from a single source; verify before committing.
avoid_when: A planner-visible or higher-tier (A/B) verified part is required.
A connector footprint or pitch outside the GROVE HW4 2.0 family is needed.
Electrical ratings, pinout, or manufacturer data are required beyond footprint/mount info.
Only through-hole is acceptable but SMD is selected, or vice versa, without checking the footprint.
